title: ORE Deal File
description: Root schema for an ORE (Open Real Estate) deal file. A .ore file is a single, self-contained JSON document conforming to this schema — all deal data and calculation assumptions travel together in one file. v0.1 scope: US industrial, DCF and direct capitalization.

formatVersion.description: ORE format version this file conforms to (semver). This schema validates 0.1.x files.
